results2026.title: This was Barranqui-IA 2026
results2026.intro: In its third consecutive edition, Barranqui-IA brought together 300 participants from 31 cities and municipalities across Colombia, more than 40 mentors and a large community team — nearly 400 people in total — to build real products with artificial intelligence in 48 hours at the Glass Cube of Plaza de la Paz.
results2026.communityNote: A young, technical community from across the coast: average age of 25, 64% junior talent in training and 22% female participation, up from 20.5% in 2025.
results2026.venueImageAlt: The Glass Cube at Plaza de la Paz full of participants during Barranqui-IA 2026
results2026.venueImageCaption: The Glass Cube at Plaza de la Paz: more than 300 participants building for 48 hours.
results2026.projectsIntro: Around 75% of the teams completed a functional submission and 10 reached the grand final. Fintech and financial inclusion dominated, followed by health.
results2026.techTrends: Two technical patterns dominated the event: voice as an interface and agent orchestration. Every team built with Cursor.
results2026.growthIntro: Barranqui-IA confirmed that the Colombian Caribbean has the talent, vision and organizational capacity to lead the national conversation on artificial intelligence.
results2026.mediaNote: El Tiempo, DPL News, Valora Analítik, La Gran Noticia and Telecaribe covered the 2026 edition, describing it as the largest artificial intelligence hackathon in the Colombian Caribbean.

about.title: What is Barranqui-IA?
about.intro: Barranqui-IA is a 48-hour hackathon where developers, entrepreneurs, designers, data lovers and builders come together to create real solutions with AI. In the 2026 edition no code was required: everyone arrived with their own idea.
about.step1: Participants chose their path: own idea, company challenges or thematic lines
about.step2: They formed 70 teams and developed functional prototypes in 48 hours
about.step3: 10 finalists presented at the grand final and competed for over +20M COP in prizes

summary2025.title: What is Barranqui-IA?
summary2025.text1: Barranqui-IA was the most exciting artificial intelligence hackathon in Colombia. A space where creative, technical and visionary people came together to solve real challenges using the power of AI. It didn't matter if they came with an idea, without a team or with prior experience: everyone was able to build, learn and transform.
summary2025.text2: During the weekend of May 3-4, participants experienced creating a solution from scratch, with the support of expert mentors, ecosystem allies and a community that believes in the power of technology to change the world. Solutions were based on the use of artificial intelligence.
summary2025.text3: At the end of the event they presented their solutions in a pitch before a specialized jury to compete for amazing prizes. On the line: over +20M COP in prizes.

location2025.title: Where was the hackathon?
location2025.intro: The Barranqui-IA hackathon took place in two amazing spaces that combined the best of the Caribbean tech ecosystem:
location2025.para1: We kicked off the hackathon on the Uninorte campus, with challenge presentation, team formation, mentoring and the first part of project development.
location2025.para2: When night fell, we moved to the Fundación Código Abierto headquarters, where the energy didn't stop. We continued working through the night in a comfortable, creative space full of good vibes.
location2025.para3: There were snacks, coffee and special dynamics to keep morale high. And yes, some participants brought their pillows and rested for a few hours.
location2025.para4: We met again at Universidad del Norte to recharge with a joint breakfast and prepare the final touches before pitches and the awards ceremony.

proponReto.title: Open innovation to transform your company with Artificial Intelligence
proponReto.subtitle: 48 hours where 450 participants will build prototypes to solve your challenge. Rate the ideas and follow up with the best ones.
proponReto.heroCta: I want to propose my challenge
proponReto.painSub: If your company identifies with any of these scenarios, Barranqui-IA was designed for you.
proponReto.pain1Desc: You pay for innovation projects that end in a PDF. What you need are functional prototypes, not diagnoses you already know.
proponReto.pain2Desc: They're busy keeping things running. They can't stop to experiment with AI or recruit specialized talent.
proponReto.pain3Title: AI is advancing and so is your competition
proponReto.pain3Desc: Every quarter without action is lost ground. But starting alone, without the right talent, is more risk than opportunity.
proponReto.shiftTitle: What if 450+ people competed for 48 hours to solve your problem with AI?
proponReto.shiftDesc: Barranqui-IA is the largest AI hackathon in the Colombian Caribbean. Companies propose real operational challenges, 450+ participants compete to solve them in 48 hours, and the best teams become startups that keep working for you through 12 weeks of acceleration.
proponReto.shiftStat1Label: of intensive work on your challenge
proponReto.shiftStat3Label: of acceleration for the winning team
proponReto.shiftCta: Here's how it works, step by step ↓
proponReto.proofTitle: Global companies already did it. You can do it in the Caribbean.
proponReto.proofSub: Corporate hackathons generate real results. Here are some documented cases.
proponReto.proof1Desc: All born from internal hackathons. Facebook has used this format as its central product innovation engine since 2007.
proponReto.proof2Desc: Their open innovation program turned $45M investment into more than triple the value. Several startups were acquired or scaled globally.
proponReto.proof3Result: From 8 to 4 months, idea to product
proponReto.proof3Desc: With FirstBuild, GE halved the time to bring a product to market using open innovation communities.
proponReto.proof4Desc: Their "Febreze Home Hack" program generated concepts like scent-diffusing alarms and smart air filtration in days.
proponReto.taxBanner: Tax benefit: By channeling your contribution through Fundación Código Abierto (ESAL, Special Tax Regime), you get a 25% discount directly on your income tax — not a deduction, a discount. Art. 257 of the Tax Code.
proponReto.packagesTitle: Two ways in. One mission: solve your challenge.
proponReto.packagesSub: Each package is designed so budget approval is clear and returns are visible from day one.
proponReto.pkgExploradorNeto: Reduced net cost after 25% tax benefit
proponReto.pkgExploradorDesc: Test the model: your challenge becomes a hackathon thematic line and you get real prototypes without acceleration commitment.

Fundación Código Abierto issues donation certificate with all legal requirements for your annual sustainability reports.
proponReto.faqTitle: Answers to what companies always ask us.
proponReto.faq1Q: What does my company gain by proposing a challenge?
proponReto.faq1A: Access to 450+ people working on your problem for 48 hours, functional AI prototypes, visibility in the tech ecosystem and talent recruitment opportunity. Thanks to Art. 257 tax benefit, the net cost is a fraction of conventional consulting project cost. Ask for participation details.
proponReto.faq2Q: What if no team chooses my challenge?
proponReto.faq2A: Costa Digital works with you on formulation to maximize challenge appeal. Challenges with competitive prizes and clear problems attract multiple teams. In case of low participation, Costa Digital can redirect teams interested in related areas.
proponReto.faq3Q: Does my company keep ownership of the solutions?
proponReto.faq3A: Hackathon code and idea are public (open source). The prototype as product belongs to the team. If you sponsor the team, you define the ownership relationship at acceleration end: you can license, invest or hire as provider. All three options are available for the Transformation Package.
proponReto.faq4A: A person from your company who acts as permanent liaison with the accelerated team during the 12 weeks. Participates in feedback sessions, ensures MVP aligns with real business needs and guarantees process visibility within your organization.
proponReto.faq5Q: Can I sponsor more than one team?
proponReto.faq5A: Yes, no limit. Each additional team requires an assigned champion. If after seeing Explorer Package prototypes you want to sponsor a team, you can do so separately. Ask about conditions for additional teams.
proponReto.faq6Q: How is my challenge confidentiality protected?
proponReto.faq6A: The challenge is formulated in general terms that allow open participation without revealing sensitive strategic information. We work with you to find the balance between problem clarity and competitive information protection.

hackathon2024.title: What is a Hackathon?
hackathon2024.para1: A Hackathon is an event where programmers, designers and entrepreneurs collaborate to develop innovative solutions in a limited time. It is an intense work environment where creativity and innovation are key to solving technological challenges.
hackathon2024.para2: During the event, participants will form multidisciplinary teams and will have 48 hours to develop functional prototypes. Topics can range from artificial intelligence to application development to solve specific societal problems.
